quote: The flow of the river is ceaseless and its water is never the same.
source: Kamo no Chōmei, An Account of My Hut, the opening sentence, Anthology of Japanese Literature (trans. Donald Keene, 1955)

evidence.where: Keene’s translation as reproduced from Anthology of Japanese Literature on Wikisource, read directly, and corroborated by the Columbia Asia for Educators reading and a separate posting of the Keene text; all three open with this sentence, followed by the sentence about bubbles that float in the pools.
